content: To investigate the effect of fine-tuning BERT on task performance, we use either the pre-trained BERT weights, or the weights from a BERT fine-tuned on the task-specific dataset on a segment-level (i.e. we preserve the original label but fine-tune on each segment separately instead of on the whole text sequence). We compare these results to using the fine-tuned segment-level BERT predictions directly as inputs to the next layer.
